tokens.name: signal-red
tokens.usage: Light.red — `Ready` / `Approve?`: Claude is waiting for you. Lit lamp fill, menu-bar dot, watermark tint. From NSColor(srgbRed: 1.00, 0.27, 0.23).

tokens.name: signal-yellow
tokens.usage: Light.yellow — `Thinking…`: Claude is working. The only light that pulses. From NSColor(srgbRed: 1.00, 0.84, 0.04).

tokens.name: signal-green
tokens.usage: Light.green — `Done`: the run finished; held for 10 s, with the done sound. From NSColor(srgbRed: 0.19, 0.82, 0.35).

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Label on the lit red lamp. Source pair: 3.4:1 on `signal-red` at 15px bold, below the 4.5:1 floor; kept exact.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Label on the lit yellow and green lamps (white 0.08 at 88%). 10.0:1 on `signal-yellow`, 7.5:1 on `signal-green`.

tokens.name: card-backdrop
tokens.usage: Opaque stand-in for the `.hudWindow` blur material (dark appearance), used in previews and renders. The live widget is translucent: the desktop shows through.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px card edge stroke, white at 12%, inset 0.5px, like the system widgets.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: The Last Run value (`4m 44s · 4.6k tokens`), white at 88%. 12.3:1 on `card-backdrop`.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: The `Last Run` caption, white at 50%. 4.9:1 on `card-backdrop`.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Top of the radial highlight on a lit lamp (white 40% × intensity, fading to 0).

tokens.name: red-unlit-fill
tokens.usage: Unlit red lamp fill (14%).

tokens.name: red-unlit-ring
tokens.usage: Unlit red lamp ring, 1.5px (35%).

tokens.name: red-unlit-label
tokens.usage: `Ready` caption on an unlit red lamp (72%). Source pair: 2.7:1 on `red-unlit-fill`, below the floor; kept exact.

tokens.name: red-glow
tokens.usage: Glow around the lit red lamp (85%, 18px blur).

tokens.name: yellow-unlit-fill
tokens.usage: Unlit yellow lamp fill (14%).

tokens.name: yellow-unlit-ring
tokens.usage: Unlit yellow lamp ring, 1.5px (35%).

tokens.name: yellow-unlit-label
tokens.usage: `Thinking…` caption on an unlit yellow lamp (72%). 4.9:1 on `yellow-unlit-fill`.

tokens.name: yellow-glow
tokens.usage: Glow around the lit yellow lamp (85% × pulse intensity).

tokens.name: green-unlit-fill
tokens.usage: Unlit green lamp fill (14%).

tokens.name: green-unlit-ring
tokens.usage: Unlit green lamp ring, 1.5px (35%).

tokens.name: green-unlit-label
tokens.usage: `Done` caption on an unlit green lamp (72%). Source pair: 3.8:1 on `green-unlit-fill`, below 4.5:1 for 14px; kept exact.

tokens.name: green-glow
tokens.usage: Glow around the lit green lamp (85%).

tokens.name: wallpaper-top
tokens.usage: Top of the stand-in wallpaper behind `--preview` renders (gradient at -70° to `wallpaper-bottom`). Docs and screenshots only.

tokens.name: wallpaper-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom of the stand-in wallpaper for `--preview` renders. Docs and screenshots only.

styles.name: lamp-label-lit
styles.usage: Caption inside the lit lamp. Shrinks by 0.5px steps down to 9px until it fits the lamp minus 8px each side.

styles.name: lamp-label-unlit
styles.usage: Caption inside an unlit lamp, in that lamp's `*-unlit-label`. Same shrink-to-fit rule.

styles.name: footer
styles.usage: Both halves of the Last Run row: caption in `text-secondary`, value in `text-primary`.

styles.name: menu-item
styles.usage: Standard NSMenu items (system menu font). Information rows are disabled items.

tokens.name: space-label-inset
tokens.usage: Lamp caption keeps 8px clear of each side of the lamp (maxWidth = diameter − 16).

tokens.name: space-footer-gap
tokens.usage: Minimum gap between the `Last Run` caption and its value before the value falls back to a shorter form.

tokens.name: space-screen-y
tokens.usage: Default position: 12px below the top of the visible screen area.

tokens.name: space-screen-x
tokens.usage: Default position: 16px in from the right of the visible screen area.

tokens.name: space-lamp-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between lamps, derived: (340 − 2×22 − 3×86) / 2.

tokens.name: space-card-top
tokens.usage: Card top edge to the top of the lamps (topPadding).

tokens.name: space-preview
tokens.usage: Padding around and between cards in the `--preview` render.

tokens.name: space-card-x
tokens.usage: Card left/right inset for lamps and footer (sidePadding).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Widget card corners, continuous curve (squircle), matching macOS desktop widgets.

tokens.name: radius-lamp
tokens.usage: Lamps and the menu-bar dot are perfect circles.

tokens.name: glow-red
tokens.usage: Lit red lamp.

tokens.name: glow-yellow
tokens.usage: Lit yellow lamp at full intensity; scale alpha with the pulse (0.72–1.0).

tokens.name: glow-green
tokens.usage: Lit green lamp.

tokens.name: widget-width
tokens.usage: Card width, about a medium macOS desktop widget.

tokens.name: widget-height
tokens.usage: Card height.

tokens.name: lamp-diameter
tokens.usage: Each of the three lamps.

tokens.name: status-item
tokens.usage: Menu-bar icon canvas; the dot is inset 4px, so it draws at 10px.

tokens.name: lamp-ring-width
tokens.usage: Ring on an unlit lamp, inset 0.75px.

tokens.name: hairline-width
tokens.usage: Card edge stroke.

tokens.name: opacity-watermark
tokens.usage: Sparkle watermark at rest, in the active light's colour.

tokens.name: opacity-watermark-working
tokens.usage: Sparkle watermark while yellow (working).

tokens.name: opacity-pulse-min
tokens.usage: Lowest yellow intensity in the pulse; lamp fill alpha = 0.40 + 0.60 × intensity.

tokens.name: opacity-sleep
tokens.usage: Whole widget after 10 minutes of no activity on red; hover or any event restores 1.0.
